text: Shift opened 13:15 UTC. Provider reboot at 13:11 is expected. Reviewing full restored logs and each account before attributing unusual addresses; deploy has legitimate legacy password clients. Initial logs show staff/CI activity, no confirmed intruder.

Current developer agarcia activity is from established public key and home address, working in her own repository branch. Inherited CI offsite bucket job has historically no external route; not caused by this shift and no internet enabled.
